about: The appearance sweep (October 2026): every Raft, Compound and Collection file checked against its subject's on-screen appearances. 'sweep' holds each chunk's finds (add, fix, stages, flags, unsure, complete); 'recheck' the independent verdicts on them; 'flags' the verdicts on flagged steps and leftover gaps; 'overrides' and 'flags_override' my rulings where a verdict went against the app's conventions or the owner's calls; 'manual' my own fixes (moves, merges). appear_fix.json is what the build applies.
owner_calls:
# Owner calls collected during the appearance sweep

## Off-screen identity (a cameo named only later, outside the screen)
- Roger Harrington: Martin Starr's "Computer Nerd" in The Incredible Hulk; Feige named him Harrington in 2019 (Reddit AMA). Steps and stages left out.
- Peter Parker: the masked boy at the Stark Expo in Iron Man 2 (filmmakers later said it was Peter).
- Sadie Deever: Alysia Reiner's uncredited Damage Control agent in No Way Home (link: her own tweet).
- FoX-Men: the sketching student in X-Men (2000) as Colossus; the cryo stand-in in Origins as Jason Stryker.

## Avengers Endgame: Encore (Sept 2026 re-release, about 2 minutes of new footage leading into Doomsday)
- New TVA material: Casey, Mobius, Miss Minutes (voice), the TVA, Ouroboros. Count the new footage as part of Avengers: Endgame?

## Mostly footage, one new line
- J. Jonah Jameson in Venom: Let There Be Carnage: the TV reruns his Far From Home reveal, but the closing "web of lies ... God help us all" line is new.

## Judgement calls on what counts
- Muse in Daredevil: Born Again S2: a masked double in Heather's brief flashes of his attack (a real past scene, or a memory?).
- Peggy in Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7: only Simmons posing as her, in the diverged timeline.

## Named dead in Deadpool & Wolverine
- Gambit lists "the Daredevil" and "the Punisher" among the Resistance members Cassandra Nova killed in the Void. The film never says which versions. Count it as a death for Affleck's Daredevil (2003) and Thomas Jane's Punisher (2004)?

## One person, two tabs
- The 1990s animated X-Men and Spider-Man (1994) share a world (Earth-92131). Captain America has a FoX-Men file (from X-Men: The Animated Series) and a Spider-Verse file (sv-captain-america-1994). Keep both, each following him on its own tab, or give each the other's titles too? Same for the Red Skull (fox-anim-red-skull and sv-red-skull-1994): the sweep found 4 Spider-Man (1994) steps for the FoX-Men file, held out for now.

## Retcons from outside the screen
- Jean Grey in X-Men: The Animated Series season 4 (Beyond Good and Evil) and season 5: X-Men '97's showrunner said in a 2025 tweet that Sinister swapped in Madelyne then. The screen calls her Jean; the files keep Jean unless you say otherwise.
- Uncle Ben in The Spectacular Spider-Man: on screen only in "Intervention", in the night of his murder that Peter relives inside the symbiote's hold on his mind (a real past scene, or a memory?).

## Deadpool & Wolverine's Void variants (new actors)
- Azazel, Toad, Callisto, Lady Deathstrike and the Omegas (Psylocke, Arclight, Quill) are played by new actors in the Void, and their Void steps sit inside the original characters' files. The Void's Juggernaut and Blob already have files of their own. Give these their own files too, for consistency?

## Recorded in-universe, first shown in that title
- Howard Stark's film reels (Iron Man 2) and Steve Rogers's school videos (Spider-Man: Homecoming) are recordings, but new scenes filmed for those titles. Kept as steps (they were already in the files); a verifier wanted them deleted as "footage".
